cover.title: Gauri Ragini, folio from a Ragamala
cover.museum: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian
cover.credit: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution, Purchase and partial gift from the Catherine and Ralph Benkaim Collection, Friends of the National Museum of Asian Art, S2018.1.49
cover.alt: A woman in saffron stands in a dark grove among peacocks and peahens, with red flowers and lotuses at her feet.

ganesha.title: The God Indra Worships Ganesha, from the Tehri Garhwal Gita Govinda
ganesha.medium: Ink and opaque watercolour on paper
ganesha.credit: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Gift of Steven Kossak, The Kronos Collections, 2021
ganesha.alt: Ganesha, orange-skinned and crowned, sits on a gold throne under a canopy while Indra kneels and touches his feet.

tour.text: Ganesha on his throne, the remover of obstacles.
Indra, king of the gods, bows at his feet.

haldi.title: Kakubha Ragini, folio from a Ragamala
haldi.museum: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian
haldi.credit: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution, Purchase and partial gift from the Catherine and Ralph Benkaim Collection, Friends of the National Museum of Asian Art, S2018.1.51
haldi.alt: A woman holding two garlands stands between two peacocks on a turmeric-yellow ground, under dark trees.

tour.text: A ragini, a musical mode, painted as a woman waiting in a grove.
In her hands, two garlands of flowers.
Peacocks gather round. In Indian poetry they call for the rain, and for love.

sangeet.title: Royal Women Celebrating Diwali
sangeet.medium: Gum tempera and gold on paper
sangeet.credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Andrew R. and Martha Holden Jennings Fund 1971.82
sangeet.alt: Women light sparklers on a palace terrace at night; gold fireworks fill the dark sky.

tour.text: Gold fireworks rise into the night.
A lady lights a sparkler on the palace terrace…

shaadi.title: Wedding Ceremony with Brahma in Attendance
shaadi.museum: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian
shaadi.credit: National Museum of Asian Art, Smithsonian Institution, Purchase and partial gift from the Catherine and Ralph Benkaim Collection, Friends of the National Museum of Asian Art, S2018.1.29
shaadi.alt: A bride and groom sit by the sacred fire under a toran of mango leaves, between towers of painted pots, as Brahma chants.

tour.text: The bride and groom sit together at the sacred fire.
Above them, a toran of mango leaves.
Brahma, the creator, chants the wedding mantras.

lotus.title: Vishnu on Ananta, the Endless Serpent
lotus.medium: Gum tempera and gold on paper
lotus.credit: The Cleveland Museum of Art, Purchase and partial gift from the Catherine and Ralph Benkaim Collection; Severance and Greta Millikin Purchase Fund 2018.155
